activity.notes: Saddam Hussein became President of Iraq on 16 July 1979 after Ahmed Hassan al-Bakr resigned. His presidency ended on 9 April 2003 when his government was overthrown during the U.S.-led invasion and Baghdad fell. ATLAS records the presidential office under Iraq and does not extend the Activity through Saddam's later period in hiding, detention, trial, or execution.

sources.title: Saddam Hussein
sources.citation_text: Encyclopedia.com identifies Saddam Hussein as President of Iraq from 1979 to 2003 and records that he became president on 16 July 1979 after al-Bakr's resignation.

sources.title: Saddam Hussein - Rise to Power
sources.citation_text: The reference biography records Saddam's assumption of the presidency on 16 July 1979 and his rule through the overthrow of the Baathist regime in 2003.
